instruction: 识别穿红色上衣、灰色长裤的人

root_causes: upper garment was narrowed to shirt, which missed jacket/workwear
wearable existence predicates duplicated the color-carrier predicates
plain overlap allowed a carrier to be shared with neighboring people
gray dominance margin was too strict for highlighted and wrinkled gray fabric

generic_fix.ownership: each carrier is assigned only to the subject that covers the largest fraction of that carrier
generic_fix.multi_attribute_logic: carrier conditions are filtered sequentially on the same base entity set (AND)
generic_fix.gray_mode: explicit fraction threshold rather than dominance margin

final_run.visual_check: the central suspended person wearing a red upper garment and gray trousers is retained
